about: The mapping-layer registry (mappingLayers ML1-b; SPEC §4.5): one entry per layer, its versions in publication order, each with an ISO/IEC 11179 registration status and administration record. A layerKey not here is refused by name; a tag is never reassigned. -publishLayer appends; nothing rewrites a version.
